headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 elements to evoke trust, luxury, and approachability. Apply tracking-tight for sizes above 32px.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, inputs, labels, and UI components. Apply leading-relaxed for better legibility.

colors.admin_note: The brand_accent color (#1E5E3F) MUST be controlled via a CSS variable (e.g., --primary) so the admin can change it dynamically.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces with subtle borders (border-border). For sticky headers over images, use Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px border-white/40). Do not use fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md) on hover states. Avoid harsh or dark drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main property cards, rounded-xl for interior images and buttons. Keeps the design friendly and approachable.

components.cards: Property cards should be borderless or have a very subtle 1px border. The image should take up 60% of the card height. Include price, city, property type, beds, area, and a like (heart) button at the top right of the image.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or soft rectangular (rounded-xl). Primary buttons use the brand_accent color.
components.forms: Inputs should have soft backgrounds (bg-gray-50), subtle borders, and focus rings using the brand_accent color. Do not use native date or select; use Shadcn components.
components.icons: Use lucide-react for all UI icons (Heart, MapPin, Bed, Maximize, User, etc.).

grids_and_layouts.homepage: Grid layout for listings (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4) with gap-8. Generous spacing (py-24).
grids_and_layouts.listing_detail: Top section uses a 'Bento' grid for images (1 main hero image spanning 2 columns, 2 smaller images stacked on the side).
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout. Dense high-utility grid for managing listings. Go cardless and rectangular here for data clarity.

motion.hover_states: Images in cards scale up slightly (scale-105) over 300ms ease. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the brand_accent color meets WCAG/APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='like-button', data-testid='contact-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'The Casa' as a fullstack app with a light theme. Project uses .js files, so configure React and Shadcn to use JavaScript, avoiding TypeScript (.tsx) extensions.
Implement the primary color (#1E5E3F) using a CSS variable (--primary) so it can be updated dynamically via the admin dashboard settings.

Generate exactly 50 fake properties on backend startup using the provided unsplash images (houses/apartments/interiors) and randomize data for the cities (Libreville, Port-Gentil, Franceville, Oyem, Lambaréné).
Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text. Add these to the Google Fonts import in index.css.
Implement the 'Like' functionality using local storage on the frontend, no user account required.
The Interest Form must collect name, contact, phone, email, post to the backend, and then redirect to home with a Sonner toast notification.
Admin Side: Protect with a default password. Build a dashboard to view/edit/delete/hide properties and view user submissions. Allow changing the site name and accent color.
Do NOT center align the app container. Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) for inner elements.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex logic (Dialogs, Select, Forms, Dropdowns) but customize them heavily via CSS classes to match the warm, sophisticated design using rounded-xl/rounded-2xl.
Ensure all interactive elements have a data-testid for automated testing.
Make sure navigation menus and headers use backdrop-blur glassmorphism if sticky, never fully transparent.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Ensure hover states use lighter hues of active states, and always explicitly set text color on hover.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
